entities.summary: Mavis Nkansah Boadu is a Ghanaian politician and the Member of parliament for Afigya Sekyere East constituency in the Ashanti Region in the 7th and 8th parliament of the 4th Republic of Ghana. She is a member of the New Patriotic Party. Mavis Nkansah Boadu was a performers & entertainers from Wiamoase (b. 1989-05-17, Wiamoase). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
